summary: You have produced an exemplary preliminary report that thoroughly establishes your mission concept. Your clear alignment with Australian stakeholders (AIMS, GBRMPA, CSIRO, BoM), robust project plan, and accurate preliminary orbital calculations set an excellent foundation. To carry this standard into your final mission design, maintain this rigour when expanding your trade-offs, detailed subsystem designs, and simulation work.
next_steps: Leverage your identified coverage-versus-resolution trade-off from 'Preliminary Progress' to guide detailed payload and swath selection in Part 2.
Progress your Gantt chart (Figure 1) tasks by initiating software simulations to validate your 600 km sun-synchronous orbit hand calculations.
Continue engaging with requirements from GBRMPA and AIMS as you transition preliminary mission goals into detailed subsystem specifications.

criteria.C1: You achieved an Accomplished level by providing a clear, quantified description of mission goals, objectives, and preliminary requirements in 'Mission Concept & Rationale'. Citing literature and explicitly linking functions to users like AIMS, GBRMPA, and CSIRO was excellent. For the final submission, maintain this standard by flowing these stakeholder requirements directly into technical subsystem specifications.
criteria.C2: You achieved the Accomplished level in 'Project Plan' by presenting a detailed task breakdown, tabulated sources, and a robust risk/contingency matrix. Linking task sequencing in Figure 1 to orbital physics provided strong justification. To maintain this level in the full assignment, track your progress against planned contingency triggers and document any baseline schedule variations.
criteria.C3: In 'Preliminary Progress', you achieved the Accomplished level with flawless hand calculations for a 600 km sun-synchronous orbit. Your interpretation demonstrated mature engineering insight by identifying the coverage-versus-resolution trade-off across the 250 km reef width. To maintain this standard for the final report, build on these calculations using orbital simulation tools to validate ground tracks and revisit rates.
criteria.C4: You met the Accomplished standard with professional report presentation. The structure is logical, language is appropriate, and captions such as Figure 1 are clear and informative. In-text citations also matched your reference list correctly. To maintain this level in your final report, continue applying consistent formatting to more complex technical diagrams, data tables, and expanded reference sections.
